sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 760. Physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 90 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 30000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 30000
Only [Traveling Flower Fairy] Lily May can be used as Unlocking Potential material
